FeedbackItem.title: Anonymous User Feedback
FeedbackItem.description: Anonymous user ratings, suggestions, general comments, and bug reports submitted from NEXA Calculator.

type.description: Category of feedback submitted by the user.

category.description: Calculator tool or area the feedback relates to.

message.description: Feedback body text submitted by the user.

page.description: Active calculator section when feedback was submitted.

deviceType.description: Coarse viewport class of the submitting device.

status.description: Admin triage status. Always initialized to 'new'.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp recorded when admin updates triage status.

AdminUser.title: Administrator Registry Entry
AdminUser.description: Optional trusted administrator UID record used for RBAC verification.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when administrator entry was created.

/feedback/{feedbackId}.description: Anonymous user feedback, ratings, suggestions, and bug reports. Public create with strict schema validation; admin-only read, triage update, and delete.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Admin role registry readable and manageable only by verified bootstrapped administrators.
